title: Cookie Attacks
description: Cookie scope, precedence, and limits that can affect authenticated sessions.

attacks.name: Cookie tossing
attacks.notes: Set cookie from sub.target.com for target.com
attacks.desc: A sibling subdomain can set a parent-domain cookie that competes with an application cookie.
attacks.prevention: Use host-only cookies with the __Host- prefix for sensitive sessions and avoid broad Domain scope.

attacks.name: Cookie shadowing
attacks.desc: A more specific cookie path can shadow a same-named cookie and change which value the server uses.
attacks.prevention: Give session cookies unique names and narrow paths; parse duplicate names deterministically and reject ambiguity.

attacks.name: Cookie jar overflow
attacks.notes: Browser cookie limits and eviction behavior
attacks.desc: Adding many cookies may evict important cookies from the browser jar and alter session behavior.

attacks.name: Subdomain cookie injection
attacks.notes: Eligible subdomain can set a parent Domain cookie
attacks.desc: A compromised subdomain can set parent-domain cookies when cookie scope permits it.

attacks.name: Cookie name collision
attacks.notes: Duplicate names, first vs last wins
attacks.desc: Duplicate cookie names can be resolved differently by a browser, proxy, and application.

attacks.name: Overlong cookie
attacks.desc: Oversized cookies may be truncated or rejected differently across components.
